svg.aria-label: How Aurex Shield blocks ads, trackers and popups
svg.title: How Aurex Shield blocks ads, trackers and popups
svg.desc: Pipeline: filter rules, host lists, popup guard, cosmetic hiding, and the four questions the popup guard asks.
svg.text: Filter lists decide first (an exception rule beats the older heuristics), then host lists. Popups are judged by behaviour.
Captcha, login and payment hosts are never blocked, so pages keep working.
The popup guard asks four things before a jump is allowed
A real tap on that very link
is remembered for a few seconds.

or a site you trusted is fine.
